name: Glipizide
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Drugs that raise hypoglycemia risk (other antidiabetics, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, fibrates, fluoxetine, MAO inhibitors, salicylates, NSAIDs, sulfonamide antibiotics, quinolones, H2 blockers, voriconazole, warfarin)
key_interactions.action: Monitor closely for hypoglycemia; watch for worse control when they are stopped.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Drugs that worsen glucose control (corticosteroids, diuretics, atypical antipsychotics, estrogens, oral contraceptives, isoniazid, niacin, protease inhibitors, sympathomimetics, thyroid hormones)
key_interactions.action: Adjust the glipizide dose; monitor glucose.
Give glipizide at least 4 hours before colesevelam.
